title: The Studio Sprint
lede: Each Studio Sprint puts a running product into production at one fixed price and one deadline, both in the contract. Each package lists what is included.

pattern.title: Your build runs on one spine, proven on our products
pattern.body: Every build runs on one repeatable spine: sign-up and login, a database, automatic releases and launch on the web or app stores. The Launch package adds an AI assistant, analytics and payments when needed. It is proven on our own products: Bloop, an AI concierge app that finds events and things to do in your city, in build and piloting in Bologna, and Washiiba, a full marketplace platform built end to end. A standard scope protects your timeline and keeps senior attention on architecture and security. The same spine fits founder MVPs, internal tools, customer portals and ops automation.

audit.name: AI-Readiness & Build Audit
audit.scope: A fixed-scope audit of your idea, your existing code or your AI plans, delivered as a report you can act on.
audit.summary: Not sure what to build yet? In about a week we review what you have, what it would take to ship, and where AI is worth using. You keep the written report whether or not you build with us.

notFor.title: When the studio is the right fit for you
items: You want a working product in production, not a mockup.
You want one studio to own delivery, not extra hands to manage.
You care more about the right outcome and a predictable timeline than the lowest bid.
You are comfortable with AI agents doing the engineering, inside human-owned code review and security gates.
You want a partner with opinions on scope and architecture.
notItems: Your scope is still open and you'd rather pay by the hour.
You need developers to add to your own team.
